channel.title: Slap Notes
channel.description: Notes on a small concatenative language

item.title: peek beats dup
item.description: Reading element i with dup copies the whole list. peek leaves it in place, so a machine threaded on the stack stops paying for its own size on every read.

item.title: Boxes & linear types
item.description: A box must be consumed exactly once. free, lend, mutate and clone are the only four ways out, and the checker counts them.

item.title: A slice is a run, not a copy
item.description: take-n and drop-n move a contiguous run in place, so neither one has a size limit any more.
